notes: The 'Case-Control: Analysis' block: Table 1 descriptive stats (PROC MEANS by ccid), a t-test on age, chi-square association tests (PROC FREQ) between COVID exposure/covariates and case status, and the first two of the paper's conditional-logistic-style PROC LOGISTIC models (unadjusted COVID+age+region, then the fuller covariate-adjusted model). Reproduced verbatim except for the LIBNAME source, replaced with a 20-row mock matched case-control cohort shaped like sub.sub7_v6_case_ctrl. The third (interaction-term) LOGISTIC model and the sensitivity/cohort/PHREG sections further down the original script were left out of this bundle to keep it focused; Covid_ModerateorSevere_Status1 was dropped from the class statement since it isn't in the mock schema and isn't referenced in the model statement.
